description.zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
description.en: The language in which you want the results to be displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English

description.zh: 针对突发请求额外允许的请求数目（效果等同于令牌桶算法的最大令牌数）
description.en: The number of additional requests allowed for burst requests. The effect is equivalent to the maximum number of tokens of the token bucket algorithm.

description.zh:
流控方式
- 0(快速失败)
- 2(排队等待)
description.en:
The flow control method. Valid values:

- 0: fast failure

- 2: wait in queue

description.zh:
规则状态
- true(开启)
- false(关闭)
description.en:
The rule status. Valid values:

- true: enabled

- false: disabled

description.zh: 超时时间，流控效果为排队等待时需要设置，单位毫秒。
description.en: The timeout period. Unit: milliseconds. This parameter is required if the ControlBehavior parameter is set to 2.

The threshold type. Valid values:

- 1 (number of requests)

description.zh:
参数描述项，JSON格式的字符串，包含以下键值对
- parseStrategy：参数属性（0: Client IP、1: RemoteHost、 2: Header、 3: URL参数）
- fieldName：Header名称/URL参数名称，仅在参数属性为2、3时填写
- matchStrategy：属性值匹配方式，仅在参数属性为2、3且需要属性值匹配时填写（0: 精确、 2: 正则、 3: 子串）
- pattern：匹配串，仅在参数属性为2、3且需要属性值匹配时填写
description.en:
The parameter description, which is a JSON string containing the following key-value pairs:

- parseStrategy: the parameter property (0: client IP address, 1: remote host, 2: header, 3: URL parameter)

- fieldName: the header name or URL parameter name. You must specify this key only if parseStrategy is set to 2 or 3

- matchStrategy: the method to match the property value. You must specify this key only if parseStrategy is set to 2 or 3 and the property value is matched. Valid values: 0 (exact match), 2 (regular expression match), and 3 (substring match)

- pattern: the match string. You must specify this key only if parseStrategy is set to 2 or 3 and the property value is matched

description.zh: 接口名称：适用该规则的应用资源。需要与控制台接口详情处接口名称一致。
description.en: The interface name: The application resources to which the rule applies. The interface name must be the same as the name on the interface details page in the console.

The resource type. Valid values:

- 0: custom interface

- 1: WEB

- 2: RPC

description.zh: 统计窗口时长（单位毫秒）：统计的时间窗口长度，默认值为1秒。
description.en: The length of the time window. Unit: milliseconds. The default value is 1000, which indicates 1 second.
